calculation.description: Measures distance from the 20-day high normalized by median 20-day true range, with the sign of the five-day trend to distinguish directional breakouts from countertrend drawdowns. Higher values favor assets near highs with positive trend.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC/ICIR: 2020-2022 0.045478/0.148810 (761 dates); 2023-2024 0.017882/0.057929 (516 dates); 2025-2027 0.021255/0.067024 (574 dates). Recent stability is below the full-sample gate; use conservatively.
